title: Compounding
explanation: Compounding means your money earns returns, and then those returns also earn returns. Over time, this snowball effect is what turns small monthly investments into large sums.

title: Inflation
explanation: Inflation is the gradual rise in prices. ₹100 today buys less than ₹100 did 10 years ago. If your money earns 3% but inflation is 6%, you are actually losing purchasing power.

title: Risk vs Return
explanation: Higher potential returns always come with higher risk. A savings account is safe but slow. Stocks can grow fast but can also fall sharply. There is no free lunch in finance.

title: SIP
explanation: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) automatically invests a fixed amount every month into a mutual fund. You do not need to time the market — you just show up consistently.

title: Diversification
tagline: Don't bet everything on one thing
explanation: Spreading money across different assets — equity, debt, gold — reduces the chance that one bad investment wipes you out. It is the closest thing to a free lunch in investing.
